{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1, as it is a sentinel for missing age
valid_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_age)"}
